positions.locationName: St. Petersburg, Florida, United States · On-site

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed the Wind River Linux Operating System LTS-24 on newly delivered ARM-based Department of Defense hardware, integrating vendor Board Support Packages, configuring U-Boot, Linux device trees, and integrating custom kernel modifications.

Refactored company repositories to support ARM processors, updating multiprocessing logic, network relevant configuration files, and executing integration and regression testing to ensure reliable operation on ARM and legacy systems.

Designed workload scheduling and processor affinity strategies for new ARM-based systems, determining optimal feature and thread placement across cores to improve parallelism, maximize compute utilization, and reduce resource contention.

Utilized Atlassian products for project management, including Jira and Confluence, to create comprehensive AGILE sprint review plans and diagrams as a Scrummaster & Product Owner.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented automated code solutions in Python and C++, integrating REST API functionality in BDD frameworks to fully automate system test procedures.

Experienced in running procedures within systems labs, familiar at working with real equipment encompassing networking between multiple co-operating units.

Utilized Atlassian products for project management, including Jira and Confluence, to create comprehensive sprint review plans and diagrams.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed software improvements for radar technologies 
Ran systems testing on simulated military equipment for deployment in the field
Implemented a Machine Learning algorithm using TensorFlow's Keras API
Utilized various Python libraries to process images for use in a Machine Learning classification algorithm
Engaged in an Agile workflow and became proficient with the Atlassian Suite in a group of 5 people using daily meetings and weekly sprints

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description:
Tutored "Intro to C Programming COP 3223C" and "Computer Science I COP 3502C" at UCF's Student Academic Resource Center
Hosted multiple 2-hour long sessions per week answering questions posed by students and hosting review sessions
Created study plans and practice exams for students preparing them for the UCF Foundation Exam

honors.title: Disney Scholar
honors.description: A $20,000 Scholarship - Disney Scholars is awarded to 100 children of Disney employees as recognition for their academic achievement. Disney looks for involvement in extracurricular activities, community service and intense academic pursuits.

honors.title: Florida Bright Futures Scholarship
honors.description: A $25,000~ Tuition Scholarship - Bright Futures is awarded to those who have high test scores in exams like the SAT and ACT, high GPA, and 100+ hours of community service.
honors.issuer: Issued by State of Florida · May 2019
